name: domain
description: Official website domain for a Startup Universe company that has none (not pre-seed or exited).
instruction: evidence.candidates lists up to 4 domains a script found by guessing name-based hosts ("guess") or from Clearbit autocomplete ("clearbit"), each with the homepage title and description it fetched. Pick the candidate that is this company's own official website, or null if none is. Be strict: startup names often collide with unrelated businesses. "high": the page shows the company name AND a business that clearly fits the Sector. "medium": the name matches and it is plausibly a venture-backed tech startup, but Sector is blank or only loosely fits, or the name is a short common word. "low" with value null: nothing fits. Reject parked or for-sale pages, unrelated businesses (bands, printers, credit unions, local firms), directories and empty pages. If two candidates both look right, prefer the one with real content, then .com. An acquirer's site is not the company's domain.
